title: Aether-Vault eval suite (GET /api/eval/suites/{id}, v1.3.1)
description: python/av_server/server.py::_eval_suite_to_dict(). Frozen, content-addressed eval definition (the held-out vault mechanism) — a training agent's token is rejected server-side on any write once frozen or without the eval:write scope. See docs/contracts.md.

object_id.description: CAS object id of the suite definition.

frozen.description: Once true, no route may mutate this suite again.

blind.description: Scores against this suite are hidden from non-scorer readers until `av eval reveal`.
